response.sql:
WITH race_name_stats AS (
  SELECT r.name,
         AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points,
         COUNT(*) AS standings_count
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(standings_count) AS avg_count
  FROM race_name_stats
)
SELECT AVG(s.avg_points),
       AVG(s.standings_count),
       AVG(s.standings_count - o.avg_count)
FROM race_name_stats AS s
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE s.standings_count > o.avg_count;

assumptions.assumption: A missing points value is ignored by AVG, while every matched standings record is included in the count.
